notes.title: Added Random Matching, Clear Rank etc.
notes.content:
- Added Random Matching
By popular demand, we have added random matching. Now you can compete with players from all around the world!

- Added Clear Rank Display in Solo Mode
Aim for a 3-star rating!

- Added How to Play Instructions
New players can now easily understand the game.

- Changed Block Rotation Center to Player's Center
Made controls more intuitive for easier stacking.

- Fixed Blocks Sticking to the Player
Addressed issues to prevent this bug.

- Adjusted UI Based on Number of Players
Improved UI for both multiplayer and solo play for a more comfortable experience.

Enjoy the new features! 🎮
